description:
Child of JMAP-sc1b.17. Add crate-jmap-mail-client/examples/mailbox_list.rs that spins up jmap_mail_server::memory::MemoryBackend behind an in-process axum server, points a JmapClient at it, queries mailboxes, and prints (~50–80 LOC). Depends on the public MemoryBackend extraction (already landed) and on jmap-mail-server's axum integration.

Acceptance:
- examples/mailbox_list.rs compiles and produces sane output.
- README.md gains a one-line link to examples/.
- cargo run --example mailbox_list -p jmap-mail-client succeeds.
- cargo build --workspace --examples clean.
notes:
Decision (2026-05-11, Mark): option (A) — wiremock + hand-written JSON fixture, matching the landed .17.2 (session_fetch) and .17.3 (dispatcher_minimal) template.

Rationale: the bead body's 'wrap MemoryBackend behind axum/hyper test server' framing was aspirational; the workspace's server crates are deliberately transport-agnostic (audit confirms zero axum/hyper/tower/tokio-tungstenite deps across all 9 server crates). The 'should workspace own transport?' question is a real architectural decision but separate from shipping these examples — filed as JMAP-l99e (epic). Examples ship via (A) now and may be retroactively redone if the epic resolves Yes-own-transport.

Implementation hint:
  - Pattern after crate-jmap-base-client/examples/session_fetch.rs (.17.2).
  - wiremock serves a single POST /jmap responding with a hand-written Mailbox/get response JSON fixture (5-10 mailboxes).
  - JmapClient is pointed at the wiremock URL.
  - Example prints the parsed mailbox names + counts.
  - README ## Examples section gets a one-liner pointing here.
  - ~80 LOC target.
title: Sub: examples/mailbox_list.rs for jmap-mail-client
